name: Wei Zhao
bio:
Wei Zhao's motorsport journey began with a fascination for Formula 1 races broadcast on television as a child. Captivated by the engineering and strategy, he pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Singapore. After graduation, he started as a junior data analyst at a local racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and knack for identifying performance improvements. He spent several years honing his skills in various technical roles before transitioning to management, where he excelled at coordinating teams and optimizing resources. 

As Sporting Director for Praga Racing, Wei is known for his meticulous approach to race preparation and his ability to foster a collaborative environment within the team. He believes in empowering his staff and encouraging them to think outside the box to find innovative solutions. His distinctive trait is his unwavering commitment to fairness and transparency, earning him the respect and trust of both his team and his competitors.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: A slim man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing stats and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong kopi (Singaporean coffee) before every race.
